description: Launchers and shared menus (D02): native application/command modes, shared chooser and confirmation, repository picker and launcher themes.

With Wofi selected press Ctrl+Super+Space (repository picker) with two repositories of the same name: both rows are distinct and each opens its own directory in the TUI editor; Escape opens nothing
